title: Line and Special Commands
body: Use enabled Special Commands in main chat. The trigger is removed. Only the configured opt-in role can be notified. Your available commands depend on current server settings and your current roles; there is no command cooldown.
line: Use !line. The host is automatically in. Members choose I’m In or I Need a Second during 60 seconds of readiness. The host can add 30 seconds once, or start early. When entries lock, check-ins remain visible and only the host can Start Countdown or Cancel Line. The host may start despite waiting members. Countdown: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, powder burst, complete. No zero, rematch or Play Again.
vc: !vc sends a voice-chat invitation to the configured opt-in role.
chess: !chess sends a chess invitation; it does not start a native chess game.
custom: Authorized enabled custom Special Commands appear in the command list. They send notifications/messages only and cannot replace native Line or Race workflows.

fields.check_in: I’m In means ready; I Need a Second means waiting. These remain visible after entry closes.
fields.host: Only the host can extend once, start or cancel.

steps: Open the authorized Special Command list.
The host extends, starts or cancels.
Watch the shared countdown and completed card.
